mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_attendance ORDER BY attendance_date DESC
SELECT * FROM t_attendance WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY attendance_date DESC
SELECT * FROM t_attendance WHERE attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} ORDER BY user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_attendance (user_id, user_name, attendance_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, work_hours, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{attendanceDate}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{workHours}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_attendance SET user_id = #{userId}, user_name = #{userName}, attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}, check_in_time = #{checkInTime}, check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, work_hours = #{workHours}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
